summary: Capacity treats exact numeric chart week ticks as supporting annotations while preserving source roles, text, QIDs, and the complete owner census.
invariants: Only QIDs matching *.chart.weekNN with the same one or two digit text qualify.
The rule applies only to capacity counting and never mutates semantic role, QID, source text, visibility, geometry, or owner census.
forbidden: Do not generalize the exception to roadmap body copy, nonnumeric labels, mismatched ticks, or three-digit values.
